propositions: Rebar's bedrock provider ignores the standard AWS_REGION environment variable and only recognizes REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION and AWS_DEFAULT_REGION, causing LLM operations to fail unless one of the latter two is explicitly set.
Botocore 1.43.62 does not consult AWS_REGION during region resolution, and rebar delegates entirely to botocore without applying its own resolver layer.
The error message documents AWS_REGION as non-functional rather than implementing a fix to close the gap between rebar's behavior and operator expectations.
Resolution order must be explicitly enforced: REBAR_LLM_BEDROCK_REGION > AWS_DEFAULT_REGION > AWS_REGION > boto3 profile fallback, with region and source recorded in provenance when resolved.
A pure resolver function must be added to bedrock_model.py that chains environment variables and config in precedence order and passes the resolved region explicitly to boto3.session.Session.

Provenance recording in capabilities.py and runner.py must capture region and region_source for bedrock runs when rebar's resolution chain succeeds, and omit them when boto3's profile resolution applies.
